title: Tierra y poder
goal: Read how land concentration from the export-era latifundio became the region's central source of social tension, and why land became the most widespread revolutionary demand on the continent.

items: Explain what effect land concentration eventually had on the region.
State why millions found themselves working land once held by their own communities.
Explain how some governments kept this discontent contained for decades.
Describe why land became the region's most widespread revolutionary demand.
Use debido a que and a causa de que to introduce a formal, structural cause.
